description.value:
Duration constant

Singularity-flavored, open to all — The Stretch worsens twice as fast per round against a target already suffering another sustained Aspect effect.

When you Sustain THE STRETCH against a creature that is already subject to another sustained effect from an Aspect SIGNATURE — yours or an ally's — it worsens by two rounds' worth instead of one. Two sustained effects on the same creature are enough; a third does not accelerate it further.

cinderfall.incomplete: Modifies THE STRETCH's per-round scaling when stacked with another sustained Aspect signature -- THE STRETCH's own sustained/escalating value is correctly a standard-condition badge (PAT-COND, no change needed there), but the stacking-detection clause ('another sustained Aspect signature is also active on this target') has no roll-option equivalent.
